metadata.description: Knowledge graph of L. Frank Baum's The Wonderful Wizard of Oz (1900). Tests the editorial discipline against a fantastical register — talking animals, animated objects, witches, transformation events. Edge labels are OCR-extracted excerpts from Baum's prose; reified events capture the major narrative pivots (cyclone, killings of the two wicked witches, the unmasking of Oz, Dorothy's return). Compared to Camus and Fanon, expect more reified events and fewer abstract concept nodes — the morals are embodied in characters and objects rather than named as concepts.
metadata.source: L. Frank Baum, The Wonderful Wizard of Oz (1900); Internet Archive scan wonderfulwizardo00baumiala.pdf, OCR via pdftotext
